entities.summary: Pablo Pereira is an Argentine former volleyball player and two-time Olympian. Pereira competed at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta and the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney. He won a gold medal with the Argentine team at the 1995 Pan American Games in Mar del Plata.
